question: The telephone was invented in:
solution:
The correct answer is __**1876.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Alexander Graham Bell** became provided the primary U.S. Patent for the discovery of the telephone** in 1876.**
 
• The primary phone had two components:** a transmitter and a receiver.**</li&g
